cases.sentence: А ___ остался в подворотне и, страдая от изуродованного бока, прижался к холодной стене.
options: пёс
пса
псу
псом
cases.translation: And the dog stayed in the gateway and, suffering from his ruined side, pressed himself against the cold wall.
cases.explain: "Пёс" is the subject of the verb "остался" (stayed), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: У самой пожарной команды у ___, из которого слышалось приятное ворчание валторны, господин наградил пса вторым куском.
options: окно
окна
окну
окном
cases.translation: Right by the fire station, at the window from which the pleasant grumble of a French horn could be heard, the gentleman rewarded the dog with a second piece.
cases.explain: The preposition "у" (by/at) always governs the genitive case, giving "окна."

cases.sentence: Кот с шипением, похожим на шипение дырявого шланга, забрался по ___ до второго этажа.
options: труба
трубы
трубе
трубой
cases.translation: The cat, hissing like a leaky hose, climbed up the drainpipe to the second floor.
cases.explain: The preposition "по" (along) marking motion along a surface governs the dative case, giving "трубе."

options: колбаса
колбасы
колбасе
колбасу
cases.explain: The implied verb of buying/asking for something takes a direct object in the accusative case: "колбасу."

cases.sentence: Негодяй в грязном колпаке, повар столовой нормального питания, плеснул ___ и обварил мне правый бок.
options: кипяток
кипятка
кипятку
кипятком
cases.translation: The villain in the dirty cap, the cook of the normal-nutrition canteen, splashed boiling water and scalded my right side.
cases.explain: The verb "плеснуть (чем?)" names the substance used without a preposition, so it takes the instrumental case: "кипятком."

cases.sentence: Неужели я обожру совет народного хозяйства, если в ___ пороюсь?
options: помойка
помойки
помойкой
помойке
cases.translation: Will I really rob the Council of National Economy blind if I rummage around in a garbage heap?
cases.explain: The preposition "в" marking location governs the prepositional case here, giving "помойке."

reading.ru: О, гляньте на меня! Я погибаю.
reading.question: How does the dog describe his own condition at the very beginning of his monologue?
options: He says he is dying/perishing
He says he is perfectly happy
He says he is very hungry but otherwise fine
He says he is looking for his owner
reading.correct: He says he is dying/perishing
reading.explain: The dog cries, 'Oh, look at me! I am perishing,' opening the monologue with his suffering.

reading.ru: Негодяй в грязном колпаке, повар столовой нормального питания, служащих Центрального Совета Народного Хозяйства, плеснул кипятком И обворил мне правый бок.
reading.question: Who scalded the dog's side with boiling water?
options: A cook from the 'normal nutrition' canteen wearing a dirty cap
A policeman chasing him away
A veterinarian trying to treat him
Another stray dog fighting over food
reading.correct: A cook from the 'normal nutrition' canteen wearing a dirty cap
reading.explain: The dog blames 'the villain in the dirty cap,' the cook of the normal-nutrition canteen, for splashing boiling water on his side.

reading.ru: До костей проело кипяточком.
reading.question: How severely does the dog say the boiling water burned him?
options: It burned right down to the bone
It only singed his fur slightly
It missed him entirely
It burned only his paw
reading.correct: It burned right down to the bone
reading.explain: The dog says the boiling water 'ate through to the bone.'

reading.ru: Судя по тому, как луком пахнет из пожарной причистинской команды.
reading.question: How does the dog guess what time it is?
options: By the smell of onions coming from the fire station
By the sound of church bells
By the position of the sun
By hearing a factory whistle
reading.correct: By the smell of onions coming from the fire station
reading.explain: The dog reasons about the time by the smell of onion coming from the fire brigade's kitchen.

reading.ru: Завтра появятся язвы, и спрашивается, чем я буду их лечить.
reading.question: What does the dog predict will happen to him tomorrow because of his untreated burn?
options: Sores/ulcers will appear on his skin
He will fully recover
He will grow a new coat of fur
He will be adopted by a rich family
reading.correct: Sores/ulcers will appear on his skin
reading.explain: The dog predicts that ulcers will appear the next day, and wonders what he will treat them with.

reading.ru: Живуч собачий дух.
reading.question: What does the dog say about his own spirit despite his suffering?
options: A dog's spirit is tenacious/hard to kill
His spirit is already broken
He has no will to live left
His spirit belongs to someone else
reading.correct: A dog's spirit is tenacious/hard to kill
reading.explain: The dog remarks 'a dog's spirit is tenacious,' showing his resilience despite the pain.

reading.ru: Я очень легко могу получить воспаление легких, а получив его, я, граждане, подохну с голоду.
reading.question: What does the dog fear will happen if he catches pneumonia?
options: He will starve to death because he can't hunt for food while sick
He will be taken to a hospital and cured
He will be given free food by the city
He will simply cough for a few days and recover
reading.correct: He will starve to death because he can't hunt for food while sick
reading.explain: The dog worries he could easily catch pneumonia, and if he does, he will starve to death since he can't scavenge for food.

reading.ru: Дворники из всех пролетариев – самая гнусная мразь.
reading.question: What is the dog's opinion of caretakers/yard-porters (дворники)?
options: They are the vilest scum among all proletarians
They are the kindest people he has met
They are the ones who feed him
They are afraid of dogs and avoid him
reading.correct: They are the vilest scum among all proletarians
reading.explain: The dog declares that yard-porters are 'the vilest scum of all the proletarians.'

reading.ru: Например, покойный Влас с причистенки.
reading.question: Who does the dog recall fondly as an example of a good cook?
options: The late Vlas from Prechistenka
The gentleman in the fur coat
Filipp Filippovich
The doorman Fyodor
reading.correct: The late Vlas from Prechistenka
reading.explain: The dog remembers the late cook Vlas from Prechistenka as an example of a decent cook who saved many dogs' lives.

reading.ru: Иная машинисточка получает по девятому разряду четыре с половиной червонца.
reading.question: What does the dog say about a typist's (машинисточка) salary?
options: She earns only four and a half chervontsy on the ninth pay grade
She earns more than any government minister
She works for free as a volunteer
She receives payment only in sausage
reading.correct: She earns only four and a half chervontsy on the ninth pay grade
reading.explain: The dog notes that a typist on the ninth pay grade earns only four and a half chervontsy.

reading.ru: У нее и верхушка правого легкого не в порядке, и женская болезнь на французской почве.
reading.question: What health problems does the dog say the typist suffers from?
options: A damaged lung and an illness contracted from her French affair
A broken arm from factory work
Blindness in one eye
Chronic toothache
reading.correct: A damaged lung and an illness contracted from her French affair
reading.explain: The dog says the typist's right lung is damaged and she has a 'female illness' from her French romantic affair.

reading.ru: Ух, Ведьма сухая метель загремела воротами и помелом съездила по уху барышню.
reading.question: What happens to a young woman (барышня) caught in the blizzard?
options: The witch-like dry blizzard rattles the gates and strikes her across the ear like a broom
She is rescued by the gentleman in the fur coat
She trips over the dog and falls
She calmly walks past unaffected by the storm
reading.correct: The witch-like dry blizzard rattles the gates and strikes her across the ear like a broom
reading.explain: The text personifies the blizzard as a witch that rattles the gates and lashes the young woman across the ear.

reading.ru: А пес остался в подворотне и, страдая от изуродованного бока, прижался к холодной стене, задохся и твердо решил, что больше отсюда никуда не пойдет, тут и сдохнет в подворотне.
reading.question: What does the dog decide to do after the young woman disappears into the storm?
options: He decides to give up and die right there in the gateway
He decides to chase after the woman
He decides to follow the cat
He decides to go home to his old owner
reading.correct: He decides to give up and die right there in the gateway
reading.explain: Suffering from his injured side, the dog presses against the cold wall and firmly decides he will go nowhere else and will die right there in the gateway.

reading.ru: Какой он к черту шарик?
reading.question: How does the dog feel about being called 'Sharik' (a name meaning 'little ball,' typically for plump dogs)?
options: He resents it, since he is thin and scrawny, not round like the name implies
He loves the name and is proud of it
He doesn't understand what the word means
He thinks it is his real, original name
reading.correct: He resents it, since he is thin and scrawny, not round like the name implies
reading.explain: The dog protests, 'What kind of Sharik is he, damn it?' since 'Sharik' implies a round, plump dog, while he is scrawny and unkempt.

reading.ru: Дверь через улицу в ярко освещенном магазине хлопнула, и из нее показался гражданин.
reading.question: What catches the dog's attention across the street?
options: A door slams at a brightly lit shop and a man steps out
A car crashes into a lamppost
Another dog starts barking loudly
A window shatters in the wind
reading.correct: A door slams at a brightly lit shop and a man steps out
reading.explain: A door slams shut at a brightly lit shop across the street, and a citizen/gentleman emerges from it.

reading.ru: О, глаза значительная вещь. Вроде барометра.
reading.question: What does the dog believe a person's eyes reveal?
options: They act like a barometer, showing what's really inside a person
They show only the color of one's clothing
They reveal nothing useful about character
They only matter for finding food
reading.correct: They act like a barometer, showing what's really inside a person
reading.explain: The dog reflects that eyes are 'a significant thing, like a barometer,' revealing a person's true nature.

reading.ru: Он умственного труда, господин, с французской остроконечной бородкой и усами, седыми, пушистыми и лихими, как у французских рыцарей, но запах по метели от него летит скверной, больницей и сигарой.
reading.question: How does the dog describe the gentleman approaching him?
options: A man of intellectual work with a pointed French beard and gray whiskers, smelling of hospital and cigar
A poor beggar with torn clothes
A young boy running an errand
A policeman in uniform
reading.correct: A man of intellectual work with a pointed French beard and gray whiskers, smelling of hospital and cigar
reading.explain: The dog describes him as a man of mental/intellectual labor with a pointed French beard and gray whiskers, though he smells of hospital and cigar.

reading.ru: — Что такое? — Колбасу.
reading.question: What does the gentleman ask for inside the shop, according to the overheard exchange?
options: Sausage
Bread
Milk
Medicine
reading.correct: Sausage
reading.explain: The overheard dialogue has someone ask 'What is it?' and the reply is simply 'Sausage.'

reading.ru: Запах, победивший больницу, райский запах рубленной кобылы с чесноком и перцем.
reading.question: How does the dog describe the smell of the sausage?
options: A heavenly smell of chopped horsemeat with garlic and pepper that overpowers even the hospital smell
A faint, barely noticeable smell
A smell of rotten fish
A smell exactly like fresh bread
reading.correct: A heavenly smell of chopped horsemeat with garlic and pepper that overpowers even the hospital smell
reading.explain: The dog calls it a smell that conquered the hospital odor, 'a heavenly smell of chopped mare's meat with garlic and pepper.'

reading.ru: Не снимая коричневых перчаток, Размотал бумагу, которой тотчас же овладела метель, и отломил кусок колбасы, называемой «особенная краковская».
reading.question: What does the gentleman do with the sausage he takes from his pocket?
options: Without removing his gloves, he unwraps it and breaks off a piece of 'special Krakow' sausage
He throws the whole sausage away
He eats it all himself in front of the dog
He gives it to the doorman instead
reading.correct: Without removing his gloves, he unwraps it and breaks off a piece of 'special Krakow' sausage
reading.explain: Still wearing his gloves, he unwraps the paper (which the blizzard immediately seizes) and breaks off a piece of the 'special Krakow' sausage.

reading.ru: Пес мгновенно оборвал кожуру, с всхлипыванием вгрызся в краковскую и сожрал ее в два счета.
reading.question: How does the dog react when he finally gets the piece of sausage?
options: He instantly tears off the casing and devours it in two bites, sobbing
He sniffs it suspiciously and walks away
He buries it in the snow for later
He shares it with the stray cat
reading.correct: He instantly tears off the casing and devours it in two bites, sobbing
reading.explain: The dog instantly tears off the casing, gnaws into the sausage with a sob of relief, and devours it in no time.

reading.ru: Ошейника нету, но вот и прекрасно. Тебя-то мне и надо.
reading.question: What does the gentleman notice and say while petting the dog's stomach?
options: That the dog has no collar, which pleases him, and that this is exactly the dog he needs
That the dog is too thin to be useful
That the dog belongs to someone else already
That the dog is diseased and should be avoided
reading.correct: That the dog has no collar, which pleases him, and that this is exactly the dog he needs
reading.explain: The gentleman notes there is no collar, says that's just fine, and declares this is exactly the dog he needs.

reading.ru: Диким воем так напугал какую-то даму, что она села на тумбу.
reading.question: What does the dog do that frightens a passing lady while following the gentleman?
options: He howls wildly, startling her so much she sits down on a bollard
He bites her ankle
He steals her handbag
He knocks her umbrella out of her hand
reading.correct: He howls wildly, startling her so much she sits down on a bollard
reading.explain: Following the gentleman, the dog lets out a wild howl that frightens a lady so badly she sits down on a stone post.

reading.ru: Здравия желаю, Филипп Филиппович!
reading.question: How does the doorman greet the gentleman, revealing his name?
options: "Good health to you, Filipp Filippovich!"
"Good evening, comrade!"
"Welcome home, Doctor Bormental!"
"Hello there, stranger!"
reading.correct: "Good health to you, Filipp Filippovich!"
reading.explain: The doorman greets him with 'Good health to you, Filipp Filippovich!' revealing the gentleman's name for the first time.

reading.ru: Точно так. Целых четыре штуки».
reading.question: What does the doorman confirm has happened involving new tenants?
options: That four new people/comrades have indeed been moved into the building
That four windows have been broken
That four dogs have been adopted
That four rooms have been renovated
reading.correct: That four new people/comrades have indeed been moved into the building
reading.explain: The doorman confirms 'Exactly so. A whole four of them,' referring to the new tenants installed in the building.
